page1.title: This alarm doesn’t stop.
page1.copy: No snooze abuse. No half-asleep dismissals. DawnVow only shuts up when you prove you’re awake.

page2.title: Prove you’re awake.
page2.copy: Answer quiz questions or get out of bed and photograph a specific object. That’s the deal.

page3.title: We need a few permissions.
page3.copy: Exact alarms to fire on time, notifications to show the ring screen, camera for photo missions. We’ll ask only when needed.

demo.question: When does DawnVow stop ringing?
demo.wrongOption: When I tap snooze ten times

page1.title: Your mornings deserve a real start.
page1.copy: Slipping back into sleep is easy. Waking up on purpose is the part that changes your day.

page2.title: Show up for your morning.
page2.copy: Answer a few questions or get up and photograph something real. Your future self will thank you.

page3.title: Just a little access.
page3.copy: Exact alarms, notifications, and camera — only when a mission needs them. We ask as we go.

demo.question: When does DawnVow stop ringing?
demo.wrongOption: When I give up and go back to sleep
demo.rightOption: When I show I’m truly awake

page1.title: Snooze is a trap. This alarm bites back.
page1.copy: Hit snooze all you want — DawnVow keeps talking until it knows your brain is actually online.

page2.title: Prove it, sleepyhead.
page2.copy: Answer a few questions or photograph something in your house. Your awake self says thanks.

page3.title: A few keys to the kingdom.
page3.copy: Exact alarms, notifications, and camera — we only knock when we need them.
